name: Kirishima Akito
source:
He comes from a fairly good family background, is good at studying, and is actually strong in stamina. He is a graduate of Kousei Gakuen and graduated from a private university's medical school, but instead of becoming a doctor he took up his current job.

[Translated from https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonourara/]
